hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. All swap execution happens in beforeSwap: it computes quotes via a custom bonding curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard pool accounting. Standard liquidity addition and donations are blocked.
